Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses BONCAT (Bio-Orthogonal Noncanonical Amino Acid Tagging) which is a specialized labeling/enrichment strategy. While PRIDE metadata mentions 'Isotope labeling', the text explicitly describes the use of a non-canonical amino acid (Anl) and biotin-streptavidin affinity purification. Quantification is performed via spectral counting (LFQ-like). No standard PTM modifier from the provided list (e.g., phospho, ubiquitin) applies, as BONCAT is a custom enrichment for newly synthesized proteins.

cell_lines: All infections were carried out using the A549 cell line (ATCC CCL-185), developed from a human lung epithelial carcinoma
scope: the azide group on azidonorleucine can then be covalently modified with an affinity tag via click chemistry (copper catalyzed cycloaddition reaction), thereby enabling enrichment of tagged proteins
affinity purification using MyOneTM Streptavidin C1 Dynabeads
Cycloaddition reaction using biotin-alkyne probe followed by streptavidin purification was performed to enrich for biotin-tagged bacterial proteins
